sources.rain: NASA POWER IMERG_PRECTOT (IMERG Final V07), daily UTC
sources.meteorology: NASA POWER T2M_MIN, T2M_MAX, RH2M, WS2M, T2MDEW, PS
sources.et0: FAO-56 Penman-Monteith daily (data/models/water_balance.et0_daily) from the POWER inputs

preprocessing.imputation: median, fitted on the training rows of each model only
preprocessing.scaling: standardization fitted on the training rows only; MLP target = residual / training residual std
preprocessing.history_base: Ridge alpha 10 per cutoff on harvest_year and published lags; a cutoff without varying features predicts its training mean
preprocessing.reference_base: published reference; missing -> mean yield of the same state over the training rows of the fit (state absent from training -> mean of all training rows)
preprocessing.feature_order: columns of the frozen feature set in the listed order, minus columns constant in training (train_v6.usable), plus horizon_days for the MLP; the exported artifact stores the final order
preprocessing.training_window: all harvests of the pool up to the cutoff year (no window selection; learning curve is exploratory)
preprocessing.seeds: MLP selection seed 11, final ensemble seeds from the protocol; HGB random_state 42
preprocessing.determinism: CUDA deterministic algorithms, CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8, fixed data order and torch generators

exclusions.municipalities: development cohort municipalities of the scope (same selection as v6/v7 cohorts)
exclusions.rows: a cutoff is dropped when any daily input of its window is missing in POWER (no gap filling)
exclusions.labels: harvest scored only when PAM 2025 area, production and yield are present and consistent (label_valid)

coverage_limits.annual_cutoffs: 30-105 days after the state sowing calendar (hypothesis)

rules.out_of_distribution: no truncation or clipping of inputs or predictions; rows with any required feature outside the training [min, max] are counted and reported, never removed
rules.training_for_evaluation: pool harvests <= 2023 outside the spatial holdout; 2022-2023 rows (already opened test) used for fitting only
rules.baselines: all simple references of the protocol available for the crop, fitted history, v7 configurations, on the same keys

decision_rule.primary_reference: strongest simple reference of the development validation (per scope)
decision_rule.confirmed: IC95 upper bound of MAE(v8) - MAE(reference) < 0 on municipalities used in training

promotion.reference: the strongest simple reference on the external validation (lowest MAE among published mean and fitted history; coffee: also the four coffee references) - a deliberately hard bar
promotion.otherwise: experimental; the winning reference is documented
promotion.note: 5% is an engineering threshold chosen in this plan, not a scientific standard

rules.classification: retrospective with documented prior exposure (availability.json, pam2025_exposure.json)

chronology.lag_rule: a PAM year enters a cutoff only if released before the decision (cutoff + 1 day); PAM 2024 (released 2025-09-11) enters no 2025 cutoff

prospective_confirmation.eligible_unit: crop x municipality x harvest x cutoff whose decision date is later than the commit of the frozen file (prediction issued before the outcome can exist), or, as a weaker level, a harvest whose PAM is still unpublished when predictions are issued and hashed
prospective_confirmation.issue_rule: both conditions: (a) prediction written and hashed on or before the decision date; (b) every input available at that date (operational sources, available_at <= decision_at); never recomputed after the PAM release
prospective_confirmation.provenance: store with each prediction the product and version of every source (e.g. IMERG Late granule name and version, POWER request time, ERA5 retrieval time, PAM release used for lags) and its retrieval timestamp
prospective_confirmation.outcome_rule: scored once against the first PAM release of that harvest, with the same references and criteria
prospective_confirmation.selection_of_harvests: chosen by these dates at issue time, not fixed in advance
